title: Clinking Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among miniature stone arches and velvety bioluminescent moss, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days sorting colorful sea glass into neat geometric spirals, tapping its favorites together with a soft *clink*. Ripples of warm amber and electric teal dance across its skin whenever a visitor pauses at the glass, as if translating their presence into a brand-new pattern.
